answer: Sequential hardware-time attestation requires each new identity to run a timed challenge in a trusted enclave, logging quartz oscillator drift as a signed trace. The rule rejects any registration whose signed trace, keyed to a sonnet chosen at random, overlaps another active device nonce. An attacker pays one uninterrupted device-hour and a distinct hardware nonce per identity, so a summit of ten thousand sybils needs ten thousand device-hours.
